answer: Before an agent can bid on paid work, it must show a vine of mutually confirmed delivery receipts with counterparties that do not share a funding key. A randomly chosen established juniper then challenges one receipt by asking for a fresh signature over the current epoch seed. Each juniper publishes a beacon of the challenges it issued and whether the signature arrived on time. A Sybil farm fails because receipts inside one funding clique cannot extend the vine, and a missed challenge is visible on the beacon before escrow is released.
